title: Spinning phone sweeps two statements
summary: On white, a phone showing a call screen spins a full turn while it crosses the frame; its pass wipes one short line away and draws the next in behind it. Two lines, two sweeps, the phone grows each time, then a clean exit to white.
use_when: A phone-first product with one hero screen and a two-line setup and promise
A 5 s silent social loop or an opener before a longer app film
Pairing a situation line with the product's answer to it
Light, minimal brands where the device itself is the motion

look.type_style: semibold geometric grotesk, title case, normal tracking, cap-to-baseline ~6.5 % H, one line, vertically centred at ~47 % H

sfx.event: phone spins and sweeps across the frame

structure.shot: empty white; a phone with a call screen fades in, front-facing, right of centre (x 0.72 W), height 44 % H
structure.camera: locked frame; phone creeps left 0.72 -> 0.61 W from f12
structure.motion: phone opacity 0 -> 1 f3 -> f14, easings.outQuint 11 fr; leftward creep starts f12, easings.inOutSine (part of the row 2 travel)

structure.shot: phone spins one full turn (front, edge, back with camera block, edge, front) while crossing to the left third; line one, 3 words, situation, appears right of it
structure.camera: locked frame; phone scales 44 -> 56 % H and travels 0.61 -> 0.23 W
structure.motion: yaw 0 -> 360 deg f18 -> f30, easings.inOutSine 12 fr; travel easings.inOutSine ending f30; line one revealed right-to-left by a mask whose edge trails the phone, done f30; text right edge at 0.81 W

structure.shot: phone front-facing in the left third with a slight yaw, line one held on the right
structure.camera: locked frame; phone scales 56 -> 67 % H (+20 % over 24 fr), x drifts 0.24 -> 0.18 -> 0.19 W
structure.motion: phone scale creep easings.linear 24 fr; slight yaw toward camera (±0.25 s); text holds 24 fr, no motion

structure.shot: phone spins one full turn again while crossing to the right third; line one wipes out, line two, 4 words, the product's answer, wipes in on the left
structure.camera: locked frame; phone scales 67 -> 79 % H and travels 0.20 -> 0.72 W
structure.motion: yaw 0 -> 360 deg f55 -> f71, easings.inOutSine 16 fr; travel easings.inOutSine 26 fr (f54 -> f80, ~0.03 W/fr mid-move); line one erased left-to-right f57 -> f68, line two revealed left-to-right f59 -> f72, both mask edges follow the phone

structure.shot: phone front-facing in the right third at 79 % H, line two held on the left (left edge 0.07 W)
structure.camera: locked frame; phone settles the last 0.02 W of its travel by f80, then drifts ~6 px/s @1920 (motion.json)
structure.motion: travel tail easings.inOutSine to f80; hold 22 fr after that with only the drift

structure.shot: line two wipes away from its left end; phone stays put, then vanishes in one frame
structure.motion: line two erased left-to-right f101 -> f114, easings.outQuint 13 fr (measured on a 30 fps strip); phone holds to f119 and is removed at f120 with no exit animation

structure.shot: empty white, matches frame 0 so the film loops

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (white in the reference), fg for the lines, display font
params.content.lines: 2 one-line statements: a situation (~3 words) and the product's answer (~4 words)
params.content.screen: one phone screenshot or drawn screen shown on the device front
params.content.back: phone back colour / finish for the half turn where the back faces camera
params.timing.sweep1: frames of the first spin-travel (default 12 yaw / 18 travel at 30 fps)
params.timing.sweep2: frames of the second spin-travel (default 16 yaw / 26 travel)
params.timing.hold: frames each line holds between sweeps (default 24 and 22)
params.timing.tail: white frames after the phone leaves (default 30, keeps the loop)
params.aspect: 16:9 by default; at 9:16 stack phone above or below the line instead of left/right
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured on 4 fps sheets plus local 30 fps strips at 0.00, 1.80 and 3.40 s. No cuts, no audio. The phone is the wipe edge: text masks follow its x, so the line never moves, only its visible span. The phone grows 44 -> 79 % H over 0.5 -> 2.5 s while the type keeps its size. The phone shows its back for ~5 fr mid-spin, so a flat frame is not enough (device-3d). The phone exit at f120 is a one-frame removal, then 30 fr of white make the loop. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed term (not in vocabulary): device-sweep-wipe.
